title: Organisation Re-Vetting Fee on SSL/TLS Certificates Renewals Carried by a Hosting Prefund
content:
# Re-vetting fee of the prefund's certificate charge

## Clause

The re-vetting fee of the prefund's certificate charge follows the product and the age of its organisation validation, counted as the days from the date it last completed to the current subscription end date plus 365: an EV product whose validation so counted is older than the product's organisation validation reuse days adds $49.00, an OV product whose validation so counted is older than it adds $29.00, and any other certificate adds no fee. The fee is a fixed sum added to the prefund's certificate charge.

| Product class | Organisation validation age (days to the current end date, plus 365) | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| EV | older than the reuse days | $49.00 |
| OV | older than the reuse days | $29.00 |
| EV or OV | within the reuse days | none |
| DV | any | none |

## Boundary (hypothetical reuse period of 400 days)

An OV subscription last validated 40 days before its current end date: 40 plus 365 is 405, older than 400, so $29.00 is added. Validated 35 days before the end date: 35 plus 365 is exactly 400, not older, so no fee.

*Applies to: Harborline Customer Accounts. Reads the certificate subscription's product, organisation validation date and subscription end date on SSL/TLS Certificates.*
